title: Splat video
description: A clip filmed from a still phone, rebuilt as moving Gaussian splats that play like the video. Drag, scroll or just move the cursor and the camera leans off the lens while it keeps playing.
intent: Puts Herb himself on the page as a video you can step into: a real player interface (play, scrub, speed, back to lens) around a custom splat renderer, on the light palette.
